==Hero Usage==
* Heroes use this skill off cooldown, even when out of combat.

== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Life]].
* This spirit heals 120-180 health throughout its lifespan with 12 ranks (or higher) in Restoration Magic.
** Effective when used with skills which reduces skill [[recharge time]] and/or destroys spirits to control the healing [[spike]].
** Life will heal for 60-90 health if refreshed every 10 seconds upon recharge (with [[Ritual Lord]]).
* This spirit will also heal allied NPCs and members of allied parties, making it effective in large or multi party missions, especially with multiple minion masters since it also heals any allied minions.
{{Anomaly|This skill will create a spirit with an offensive appearance.}}

== Trivia ==
